fields.FIR_Description: According to the complaint registered on 2026-02-20, the complainant parked a silver motorcycle bearing registration number TN-28-YY-1070 at Vetri Layout Industrial Area in Coimbatore and found it missing on return. The incident is stated to have occurred on 2026-02-18 around 04:35 hrs. The complaint refers to Venkat Palanisamy, an intermediary, reachable on 9000000134. The identity of the person involved remains unknown at this stage. Potentially relevant material referenced includes a vehicle observation.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Motorcycle allegedly driven away after the lock was forced.
fields.Keywords: motorcycle theft, vehicle, early morning, associate, industrial area, vehicle observation, motorcycle
